abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe the prevalence of gestational trophoblastic disease in ectopic pregnancy. STUDY DESIGN: Medical records of 105 patients from January 2007 to October 2009. We excluded of the study 5 cases (one case where the answer of the biopsy was not clear; 4 others with diagnosis of adhnexial mass where the pregnancy test had resulted positive but the answer of biopsy have been resulted ruptured ovary cyst and pyosalpingitis). So definitely the size of the sample was 100 patients. RESULTS: 79 patients with EP underwent surgery due to a (diagnosis of EP with hem peritoneum and enraptured ectopic pregnancy) and in 18 of them the answer of the biopsy was GTD. 4 of 75 cases admitted in our hospital with diagnosis of EP, (pregnancy test was used instead of estimation of the level of β-hCG because our hospital couldn't offer estimation of the level of β-hCG during 24 hours) have been not confirmed diagnosis of EP by biopsy, but ruptured ovary cyst with hem peritoneum, pyosalpingitis.31 cases with EP (enraptured EP) underwent medical treatment with methotroxate. In 10 cases last management was failed and surgical intervention was institutionalized and histological analysis revealed GTD in 6 of them (partial mole). β-hCG level was detected in 31 cases with enraptured fallopian pregnancy; in all cases where treatment with methotroxate has been failed and GTD was confirmed, the level of β-hCG was > 10.234 mUI/ml. 21 cases with enraptured fallopian pregnancy were successfully treated, and at this point we never learned the answer of biopsy. We registered one case with cervical pregnancy and one cornual (interstitial portion) pregnancy. CONCLUSION: we found 18 cases of GTD in EP /11.500 deliveries (1,56 per 1,000 deliveries), prevalence of the GTD in EP was about 18%.
abstract_ja: 目的:異所性妊娠における妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の有病率を記述すること。研究デザイン:2007年1月から2009年10月までの105例の診療記録を検討した。このうち5例を除外した(生検結果が不明確であった1例、および妊娠反応は陽性であったが生検で卵巣嚢腫破裂や卵管膿瘍と判明した付属器腫瘤の4例)。したがって対象は100例であった。結果:79例が異所性妊娠として手術を受け、そのうち18例で生検結果がGTDであった。入院し異所性妊娠と診断された75例のうち4例は異所性妊娠が確認されず、卵巣嚢腫破裂による血腹症と卵管膿瘍であった。β-hCG値の定量が24時間以内に行えなかったため、妊娠反応検査が代わりに用いられた。31例は破裂異所性妊娠としてメトトレキサートによる治療を受けた。10例で治療が失敗し手術が行われ、そのうち6例で組織学的にGTD(部分奇胎)が認められた。β-hCG値は31例で測定され、メトトレキサート治療が失敗しGTDが確認された全例で、β-hCG値は10.234 mIU/mL超であった。破裂卵管妊娠の21例は治療に成功し、その後の生検結果は得られなかった。頸管妊娠1例と子宮角(間質部)妊娠1例も認められた。結論:異所性妊娠においてGTDは18例で確認され、出生1,000件あたり1.56例に相当した。異所性妊娠におけるGTDの有病率は約18%であった。
